scope: Independent pixel review of the 16 PNGs listed by capture-manifest.json: three opening selection frames and one opening gameplay frame at each of four screen profiles. This does not assess other game states, saved journeys, combat animation, or audio.

provenance.inspection: Every referenced PNG was opened with the image tool at original or high detail. Fifteen unchanged PNGs were also compared against ui-final-review-round1 by SHA-256; narrow-desktop-gameplay.png was independently inspected as the changed frame.
